notes: Scene source: MI 6800C brochure (2021, 8 pp.) and the mintl.com product page, which repeats the brochure text; no third-party facility paper naming the 6800C was found, and MI does not publish cryostat footprint, height or weight. Configuration CFMS-9T-30-H3: 9 T vertical-field cryogen-free magnet (52 mm bore, 0.02 % over 1 cm3, 120 A / 5 V supply), 30 mm VTI with JT-condensed 4He gas loop and external scroll pump to 1.3 K, two-stage pulse-tube cryocooler (35 W @ 45 K / 0.9 W @ 4.2 K, F70 water-cooled compressor, 30,000-40,000 h service), top-loading airlock + gate valve, dual TO-8 probe with 8 PTFE-insulated silver wires per socket (16 sample lines total). No optical windows: the sample is enclosed in a VTI accessed only via airlock. 3He insert (22 mm OD, < 300 mK) and 14 T / 40 mm VTI are options not in this configuration. Rendering guidance: draw a vertical cylinder with top-mounted airlock/gate valve and probe, a separate 444 x 529 x 576 mm compressor box, and the 6020Q bridge rack; treat the outer-can dimensions as unknown.
